checks.description: Proof 1, qa/evidence-proof-1.txt: MISTER_CLEAN_SOURCE_DEVELOPMENT=1 node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --allowOnly=false --testTimeout=120000 src/closeout/inspection.test.ts -t "file-url" at the frozen head: exit 0, 1 passed | 15 skipped. The near-miss test asserts bare schemes followed by punctuation or whitespace are not findings, while an absolute path, a host, and a home directory are (the home case yielding both posix-home-path and file-url). Mutant half, qa/evidence-mutants.txt: in a git-archive copy of the same head with the previous pattern ["file-url", /\bfile:\/\/[^\s)>'\"]+/i] restored (only that line changed, verified by diff), the same command exits 1 with "reports file-url only when the scheme is followed by a host or path" failing, kinds.txt line 1 and line 2 coming back as unexpected file-url findings. Checkout never edited; all mutation confined to ~/.../ci-green-1/qa/scratch/repo.

Proof 2, qa/evidence-proof-2.txt: same runner with -t "keeps the prospective public source tree free of private identifiers" at the frozen head: exit 0, 1 passed | 15 skipped, status pass with findings []. Mutant half, qa/evidence-mutants.txt: with the previous pattern restored in the scratch copy the same command exits 1, findings non-empty and pointing at qa/mg-s1b-git-env-hardening/receipt-chqa-proofs1-7.json line 22 with rule file-url - exactly the finding location and line the DONE contract predicts. Home-directory prefix written as ~/; output otherwise retained.

Proof 3, qa/evidence-proof-3.txt: bun run build:raw (bun 1.4.0, matching .bun-version) in a fresh git-archive copy of the head at ~/.../ci-green-1/qa/scratch/repo3: exit 0, manifest: wrote 82 entries. Regenerated outputs are byte-identical to the frozen ones - cmp bin/mister-clean.js and cmp MANIFEST.sha256 both IDENTICAL; sha256(bin)=640a231b2cffc78e3e58f82d399f59b605d35989f4576c7e743f7b747eec6e9e and sha256(MANIFEST.sha256)=857c34f4f5e443e9c8bb24304093f18b4d28d176dd1532453709adf023157bfd on both sides. Then pnpm exec tsc --noEmit exit 0; bun run sync:cli:check exit 0; bun run manifest:package:check exit 0 (manifest: PASS (82 entries)); and the named vitest pair (inspection.test.ts + public-safety-provenance.test.ts) exit 0, 2 files passed, 22 tests passed. Note on method: a git archive carries no .git, and MISTER_CLEAN_SOURCE_DEVELOPMENT=1 refuses to run without a repository root at the package root, so the scratch copy had its own git init + commit; the frozen checkout was written to zero times. The charter manifest_sha256 49b3e5... is the charter.freeze/2 git-commit-tree digest over head 0a9f26b (entry_count 518), not a hash of MANIFEST.sha256 - confirmed directly from charter/.freeze/mg-ci-green-1.json on the branch tip.

Proof 4, qa/evidence-proof-4.txt: gh run list --commit 0a9f26bb0a59f5b11fa23f66f3ad5cd3f6a30f42 returned [] - no workflow run is registered on the frozen head itself, so the run was located on the branch as the task anticipated: CI run 42194192164 on branch mg/ci-green-1, headSha a419bdb39f61705cba34681d0f79fe8dc462344d, the branch tip. git diff --stat 0a9f26b a419bdb shows exactly one file, charter/.freeze/mg-ci-green-1.json (+3639), i.e. only the freeze record on top of the frozen head, whose commit/head fields are 0a9f26bb0a59f5b11fa23f66f3ad5cd3f6a30f42; no source, test or generated byte differs. timeout 1800 gh run watch 42194192164 completed; gh run view 42194192164 --json jobs,headSha (saved verbatim) gives required job verify = completed/success, including the clean-capsule steps. The run's overall conclusion is failure solely because of the job literally named "charter (non-required; fails as NOT CHECKED while the charter source is unreachable)", which fails at "probe the charter source"; .github/main-ruleset.json requires only verify and dependency-audit, and both pass (dependency-audit run 42194192142 success). Baseline check: pre-slice run 42188850358 on 4240c0e6bc460152b8b9e3c14e5683c5745a7910 has verify = failure and the same charter job failing identically, so verify went failure -> success on this slice and the charter job is pre-existing, not introduced. Account name in the repo slug redacted here for the no-personal-data rule; the literal command is retained in the evidence file as the task specified.

Proof 5 (pre-merge self-judge), checked against the raw judge outputs, not the summary. (a) HEAD: selfjudge/judge.log opens "HEAD a419bdb39f61705cba34681d0f79fe8dc462344d up origin/mg/ci-green-1", judge.sh aborts with WRONG-HEAD (exit 2) unless rev-parse HEAD equals that sha, and judge.log ends "prepare exit 0" + "docker exit 0"; closeout-report.json repo.commit, target_binding.candidate_commit/merge_base and public-safety-audit.json repository_object.head_commit are all a419bdb39f61705cba34681d0f79fe8dc462344d, so the judge cloned a419bdb. (b) prepare exit 0: judge.log; prepare.err holds only a Node SQLite ExperimentalWarning plus the receipt line (id=mc-receipt:ac904fbe-499b-4d7e-9f4d-c7b6b3b9ff38, mode=CLOSE, findings=6 across github_actions, language_policy, planning_graph, public_safety, semantic_boundary), no error; prepare.out is the evidence path. (c) debt classes: closeout-report.json completion_debts are exactly the five the summary lists - public_safety_file-url DEBT-PUBLIC-SAFETY-76269CC852B99829 / -8EDA1B26EC22165C / -11D91857A80C69F7, semantic_probe_set_unassigned DEBT-SEMANTIC-SET-9E8D2EFD9C007657, native_gate_failed DEBT-NATIVE-GATE-17ED5EBED7B18D8C (debt_census discovered 5, paid 0) - and every class is in main's baseline. semantic_probe_set_unassigned and native_gate_failed are the baseline self-judge classes in s1b/selfjudge-candidate/evidence-proof-8.txt (DEBT-SEMANTIC-SET-095FE37B4AF3C294, a new id for the same class as LIFECYCLE.md records for S0, and the byte-identical DEBT-NATIVE-GATE-17ED5EBED7B18D8C). public_safety_file-url is on main itself: LIFECYCLE.md records "slice mg-ci-green-1 (main CI red since S1b: file-url false positive)" and the S1b public-safety file-url literal, and the identical instance qa/mg-s1b-git-env-hardening/receipt-chqa-proofs1-7.json:22 fingerprint 11d91857a80c69f7 sits on main (slice base 4240c0e; the DONE contract keeps that accepted receipt byte-for-byte unchanged), which is the hosted-CI failure this slice fixes. Two caveats recorded rather than assumed: evidence-proof-8.txt runs before the S1b acceptance-records commit 4c236c9 and therefore lists no public_safety debt at all, so that class's baseline presence rests on LIFECYCLE.md plus the identical instance on main, not on the baseline self-judge's debt list; and closeout-report.json regression_control.baseline_repository_object.head_commit is a419bdb, the candidate itself, so the run's own origin.class="baseline" labels are self-referential and were not used as baseline evidence here. (d) the two new instances: `sed -n 2p;4p` on charter/DONE/mg-ci-green-1.md shows line 2 quoting the bare scheme `file://,` and line 4 quoting `file://,`, `file://)` and `file:// ` - bare schemes only, no host or path character after the scheme; public-safety-audit.json holds exactly two findings for that path, lines 2 and 4, both rule file-url (fingerprints 76269cc852b99829 and 8eda1b26ec22165c), the third finding being the baseline instance at qa/mg-s1b-git-env-hardening/receipt-chqa-proofs1-7.json:22. Why these new instances do not matter for the verdict: they are instances of a class already known on main, they are exactly the near-miss domain the DONE list quotes as prose, under this slice's narrowed file-url rule they are not findings (proof 2 green on the same tree; receipt-1-4 C02 shows only the retired pattern flags them), and hosted CI verify on a419bdb is green under the new rule (C04), so no class appears beyond main's baseline and no CI regression is introduced; the pinned 7.5.1 still applies the retired rule, which is why it reports them. (e) ci-check: native-gate-output/node-.-ci-check.*.stderr.bin has three test FAILs, each "Error: Test timed out in 5000ms", all inside the control-plane bun run `pnpm exec -- bun ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --allowOnly=false src/control-plane` - sqlite-store identity-unbound credit, evaluation-intake.e2e authenticated local HTTP aliases, snapshot-producer admitted-run composition - plus the fourth FAIL line "clean ci: FAIL (supervised command exited 1: pnpm)"; the same gate's stdout reports "Test Files 67 passed (67) / Tests 1041 passed | 1 skipped (1042)" for the non-control-plane node suite and "Test Files 3 failed | 29 passed (32) / Tests 3 failed | 213 passed (216)" for the control-plane suite, matching the summary. Gate result native-gate-501f29fe5eca2a0a.json gives gate_id node:.:ci-check observed_status 1, and the debt id DEBT-NATIVE-GATE-17ED5EBED7B18D8C (cause gate_id node:.:ci-check) is the same id recorded in baseline evidence-proof-8.txt, with the same control-plane load-timeout mechanism LIFECYCLE.md records for the baseline ("2 load timeouts in the sqlite tests"; this run has 3, one of them the same sqlite-store test - same gate, same id, same class). No defect: every summary claim checked against the raw files held, including the debt list, the finding list, the native-gate statuses and the ci-check failure description.
